description: This file is a code-behind for the ShowAns.aspx page in an online examination system. It handles displaying answers for specific questions, submitting marks, and navigation. It interacts with a SQL database to retrieve and update student answers and course data.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for ShowAns.aspx handling page load, data retrieval, submission, and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Retrieves student answers from the database based on session IDs and populates the page controls.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database records for marks and queue, and navigates to the AdminCourseQueue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by navigating to the LoginPage.

search-terms: Get answers by studentID and courseID
